_about: CR-11 visual parity record. Each Playwright baseline (tests/e2e/__visual__/<env>/<surface>.png, tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts) is paired with the legacy capture it was compared against side by side (docs/ui/baseline/*.webp, the original Resuto app). Status "approved" may only be set by the owner after looking at the pair; "candidate" means the side-by-side was produced and reviewed by the implementing workstream but not yet approved. Composites: scratchpad evidence ws10a-data-qa/cr11-legacy-vs-new/.

local.determinism: two consecutive runs against the same baselines passed within 1 % (maxDiffPixelRatio 0.01)
local.rerecordNote: 21-MIGRATE re-recorded the six local baselines made stale by the 2.1 redesign (landing-ar-mobile, staff-overview-en, staff-floor-en, staff-orders-en, staff-settings-en, kds-en; 2.7–10.2 % of pixels changed; landing-ar-mobile-hero in landing.spec.ts 8.8 %) and added 15 staff surfaces (EN/AR × desktop/phone) with `E2E_VISUAL=1 pnpm e2e --project=visual --update-snapshots`; a second run without --update-snapshots passed 7/7. The other eight baselines were unchanged (within 1 %). Pending owner review.
local.rerecorded22Note: 22-TYPE re-recorded the 18 local staff baselines changed by the bilingual typography and sidebar refinement (text tokens, nav type tokens, Arabic type offsets, the public-site logo in the shell, the rebuilt sidebar): staff-customers-ar-mobile, staff-customers-en, staff-floor-en, staff-loyalty-ar, staff-marketing-ar-mobile, staff-marketing-en, staff-mcp-en, staff-menu-ar, staff-menu-en, staff-orders-ar-mobile, staff-orders-en, staff-overview-ar-mobile, staff-overview-ar, staff-overview-en-mobile, staff-overview-en, staff-payments-en, staff-settings-ar, staff-settings-en. Recorded with `E2E_VISUAL=1 pnpm e2e --project=visual -g staff --update-snapshots`; a second run without --update-snapshots passed 2/2. kds-en and the public/guest baselines were unchanged. Pending owner review.

docker.note: Recorded by the CI job "visual" in mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.56.1-noble (E2E_RECORD_MISSING_BASELINES=1, tests/e2e/fixtures.ts matchScreenshot): missing baselines are written and uploaded as the visual-baselines artifact; commit them after approval. Existing ones are enforced.
docker.note21: 21-MIGRATE (2026-10-26): no docker daemon was available to the agent, so no docker baselines were recorded; the CI job "visual" records them (E2E_RECORD_MISSING_BASELINES=1), including the 15 new staff surfaces.
